description.en: A gracile bipedal reconstruction with a long shallow snout and three nasal bumps. The anchor is an immature Alioramus altai; missing limbs, soft tissues and pose are inferred, and adult proportions or absence of feathers are not asserted.
description.zh: 纤细双足复原，具有长浅吻和三处鼻隆突。依据未成年Alioramus altai，缺失肢骨、软组织与姿态为推断，不宣称成年比例或确定无羽。

diagnostic_targets: Very long shallow snout, approximately anterior two-thirds of skull length, not a deep robust Tyrannosaurus head.
Three discrete modest midline nasal bumps visible in side view, based on Fig1B actual fossil and text; not six tall horns from A.remotus.
Paired lateral jugal horn projections behind mouth and modest orbital ornament; lateral jugal horn differs from ventral cornual process.
Slender trunk and elongated hindlimbs, short inferred two-fingered forelimbs, palms inward, long balanced tail.
Entire animal with skin-covered bones; skeletal windows are not holes in the living face.

scale.basis: Australian Museum about6m estimate; Fig3 reconstruction uses2m scale bar; not complete fossil measurement.

scientific_limits.en: IGM100/1844 is a nine-year-old juvenile, not a documented adult. Nearly complete disarticulated skull plus partial postcranium; forelimbs, pubes, regions of hindlimbs and much of dorsal/caudal series are missing. Fig3 fills missing regions; skin, colour, muscle contours and pose inferred. About6m is AustralianMuseum estimate, not measured complete fossil. Adopt three nasal rugosities of A.altai, not six more prominent bumps of A.remotus. Do not claim adult proportions or feather absence established.
scientific_limits.zh: IGM100/1844为9岁未成年，非已证实成年比例。近完整散离头骨加部分躯体，前肢、耻骨、部分后肢及较多背尾椎缺失，图3含补配。皮肤、颜色、肌肉轮廓及姿态推定。约6米为澳洲博物馆估计非完整化石实测。采用A.altai三处鼻隆突，不混A.remotus六处显著隆突；不能断言无羽。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole gracile biped with exceptionally long shallow snout and a row of nasal bumps, full trunk, limbs and long balancing tail; not isolated skull.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Brusatte etal2009 IGM100/1844 Fig1 true maxilla/nasal/lacrimal/jugal/dentary photos and composite skull drawing, Fig3 partial skeleton reconstruction and true cervical photos, actually viewed.

reference_credits.title: Brusatte etal2009 A long-snouted multihorned tyrannosaurid from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia
